selection_firewall.selection_basis: MC02 dissociation/fragmentation ontology gap plus availability of a separately published direct gas-phase kinetic comparator; no predicted-versus-observed residual, chi, or ChemSA expectation selected this family or the electronic-structure method

classification_basis: The physical event cleaves the terminal N-O bond and produces two separated fragments, N2 and O(3P).
It is not an electrocyclic ring opening and therefore does not repurpose the refused cyclobutene MC02 trail.
It is physically distinct from the frozen FAM-GAS-CYCLOBUTANE-RING-OPENING family.

barrier_source.authors: Tien V. Pham, T. J. Tsay, M. C. Lin
barrier_source.title: Thermal decomposition of N2O near 900 K studied by FTIR spectrometry: Comparison of experimental and theoretical O(3P) formation kinetics

reported_quantity.type: reported ab initio minimum-energy crossing-point (MSX) energy for the spin-forbidden N2O(X1Sigma+) -> N2(X1Sigma_g+) + O(3P) transition, relative to the N2O ground-state reference used by the source

source_theoretical_rate_expression_quara.reason: The 2020 source explicitly compares these NA-RRKM predictions with literature kinetics. The campaign does not use that agreement to choose, rank, or promote the candidate.

observed_comparator.authors: Michael Roehrig, Eric L. Petersen, David F. Davidson, Ronald K. Hanson
observed_comparator.title: The pressure dependence of the thermal decomposition of N2O
observed_comparator.measurement: shock-wave N2O concentration histories measured by infrared emission
observed_comparator.reported_model_range_note: The authors state that their limiting coefficients are suitable for kinetic modeling over approximately 800-2000 K and pressures up to 450 atm.
observed_comparator.activation_energy_quarantine: The 262 +/- 3 kJ/mol Arrhenius term is rate-derived from the experimental kinetics and is not treated as an independent barrier measurement.

condition_basis: Both evidence chains concern isolated gas-phase N2O dissociation to N2 + O(3P), with no solvent or solution standard-state conversion.
The comparator is explicitly the experimentally reconstructed high-pressure limiting first-order rate, so falloff is not silently mixed into a single-pressure rate constant.
The 60.1 kcal/mol MSX quantity is an electronic crossing-point energy and is therefore not assigned an artificial experimental temperature.
independence_basis: The 1996 comparator is a separate primary shock-wave experiment published 24 years before the 2020 ab initio source.
The selected 60.1 kcal/mol quantity is the source's explicitly reported high-level ab initio crossing-point prediction, not a parameter regressed to the 1996 rate expression.
The campaign does not use the 2020 paper's stated rate-agreement quality as evidence for promotion.
No residual, chi value, or expected ChemSA agreement has been computed or used to select this candidate.
representation_basis: The reaction is spin-forbidden from singlet N2O to triplet O products and therefore requires an intersystem-crossing bottleneck rather than a conventional single adiabatic saddle-point label.
The experimental kinetics are pressure dependent, so the registered comparator is explicitly the high-pressure limiting branch rather than an arbitrary finite-pressure scalar.
Future coordinate adjudication must retain the MSX/nonadiabatic and high-pressure-limit semantics.
adjudication_caveat: READY_FOR_ADJUDICATION is not admission. Any future coordinate must be added only in a new Atlas release and must preserve the network-resolved spin-crossing representation; Barrier_Height_Rate_Atlas_v0.9 remains immutable.
